title.narrative: In 2024 Resource Mobilisation from public and private sector supported the implementation of Country Programme Document and the Humanitarian Action for Children. The CPD target (2023-2027) of USD 101.4 million in Other Resources is on track with USD 32 million in contribution agreements secured; and USD 26 million; available for implementation in 2024.; Humanitarian Action for Children appeals were 73%; funded with a total of USD 29 million against needs of USD 40 million.Flexible funding from BPRM allowed UNICEF Egypt to quickly respond to the influx of; displaced populations from Sudan and respond to the Gaza conflict. Additional funds were secured for humanitarian response: a generous contribution from EU FPI, while earmarked as nexus funding, allowed UNICEF Egypt to flexibly reallocate expenses and mobilize additional contribution from GFFO emergency funding.
